sanskrit_verse: न परेण समुद्दिष्टम् उपैयात् साक्षिणं रहः । भेदयेत् तं न चान्येन हीयेतैवं समाचरन् ॥
transliteration: na pareṇa samuddiṣṭam upeyāt sākṣiṇaṃ rahaḥ | bhedayet taṃ na cānyena hīyetaivaṃ samācaran ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must not approach a witness in private who has been designated by another; nor should one cause that witness to be influenced by another—such conduct constitutes a violation of dharma and disrupts the integrity of testimony.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in the undisturbed capacity of the witness to testify truthfully
Causation arises from interference with the witness’s conscious alignment to truth
Capacity-based responsibility lies with the party attempting indirect influence
Restoration logic demands purification of the testimony process and realignment of involved consciousness
Consciousness alignment requires transparency and non-manipulation in judicial processes
executable_legal_axioms: IF any party approaches a witness privately without authorization THEN disqualify the witness's testimony from legal consideration
IF any external influence is detected on a witness THEN initiate automatic integrity restoration protocol for all related judicial proceedings
IF a witness is found to have been approached indirectly through third parties THEN invalidate all actions based on that testimony until realignment is confirmed
IF a party causes deviation in witness testimony through manipulation THEN assign completion process for reintegration of truthful capacity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes the threshold of responsibility at the level of consciousness-presence during testimony. The court must ensure no indirect manipulation occurs, maintaining the witness's alignment with satya-dharma. Authority resides in preserving the causal purity of evidence, not punishing misconduct.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the root disturbance in testimony as originating from concealed contact. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces the effect of such contact upon the outcome of justice. Proportional responsibility lies entirely with the influencing agent. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction restores the witness’s capacity rather than inflicting consequence upon the influencer.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Witness Consciousness Realignment Process to restore satya-vāk alignment
Deploy Testimony Integrity Purification Protocol across affected case files
Assign Responsibility Assumption Completion to the influencing party for dharmic reintegration
Enforce Transparent Judicial Engagement Rules to prevent future violations
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of Dharma. This law upholds the sanctity of testimony through consciousness-aligned enforcement. Justice is executed through restoration, not punishment. Reality responds only to alignment, never to retribution. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator.
